body.name: Exact cluster-mean kernel
body.construction: For \(t\in\mathcal T\), \(r\in\mathcal R\), and \(x\in\mathcal X_n\), define \[Q_{tr}(x)=\binom{n}{k_r}^{-1}\sum_{\substack{0\le j_{ab}\le N_r^{ab},\ \sum_{a,b}j_{ab}=k_r}}\mathbf 1\!\left\{x=\frac{N_r^{10}+N_r^{11}-j_{10}+j_{01}}{n}\right\}\prod_{a,b\in\{0,1\}}\binom{N_r^{ab}}{j_{ab}}.\]
